items.title: Chamath says open AI models are "commoditize your complement." Agree?
items.raw_excerpt: Chamath's argument (https://research.socialcapital.com/p/open-vs-closed): companies give away the thing they dont sell for free, so the thing they do sell is worth more. Meta makes money though ads, Google and Microsoft from cloud. The losers are companies whose business is selling access to closed models. But still companies are paying more and mroe for closed models anyway! Does this theory hold up?

excerpt_i18n.zh: Chamath 的论点（https://research.socialcapital.com/p/open-vs-closed）：公司免费赠送自己不卖的东西，所以他们出售的东西更值钱。Meta 靠广告赚钱，谷歌和微软

items.title: Without search, even the best AI models get 1 in 4 answers wrong
items.raw_excerpt: Without access to search, even the best AI models get roughly one in four answers wrong, underscoring how important retrieval and search integration are for improving factual accuracy.

title_i18n.zh: 不进行搜索，即使最优秀的AI模型也有四分之一的答案出错
title_i18n.es: Sin búsqueda, incluso los mejores modelos de IA se equivocan en 1 de cada 4 respuestas.

excerpt_i18n.en: Without access to search, even the best AI models get roughly one in four answers wrong, underscoring how important retrieval and search integration are for improving factual accuracy.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 有观点指出，若不借助搜索能力，即便是当前最优秀的 AI 模型在回答问题时也容易出现错误，出错比例约为四分之一。这说明将模型与检索/搜索结合，对提升回答的准确性和可靠性十分关键。

items.title: People will be AI's app layer
items.raw_excerpt: The piece argues that as AI models grow more general, people themselves will become the "app layer" for AI—supplying context, judgment, and domain framing that turn raw model capability into real value. It suggests future products may center less on traditional apps and more on how humans orchestrate and apply models.

title_i18n.en: People will be AI's app layer
title_i18n.zh: 人类将成为 AI 的应用层
title_i18n.es: Las personas serán la capa de aplicaciones de la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: The piece argues that as AI models grow more general, people themselves will become the "app layer" for AI—supplying context, judgment, and domain framing that turn raw model capability into real value. It suggests future products may center less on traditional apps and more on how humans orchestrate and apply models.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该观点认为，随着 AI 模型能力不断通用化，传统应用层软件的中间角色将被削弱，人本身会成为 AI 的“应用层”——由人来理解具体场景、组织上下文并把模型能力落地为实际价值。作者由此提出，未来的产品形态可能不再以 App 为中心，而是围绕人如何调用与编排模型来展开。

items.title: Build agent memory with NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit and Amazon S3 Vectors

items.title: Uplifting conversion across the acquisition funnel with personalization using contextual bandits on AWS
